entries.reason: The tree view and hidden-node lifecycle: the one owner of the hidden predicate
Live mover: CAS-inspects through the view, moves and deletes rows, enumerates subtrees including hidden contents (they move with their folder; absorb and split need them)
Namespace and moved-row locks, subtree enumeration: identity by id, no visibility answer
Previous-location lookup: a history row names the document; access by project ownership; hidden documents have no history rows until reveal
Work-owned sources (scratch, uploads) only, never drafted, so never hidden: cascade soft-delete and restore, bumping location_version
Lists chats that hold uploads: existence by chat-scoped source, uploads are never drafted, so never hidden
Work purge: collects the stored objects of every row (live, hidden and deleted) in the sources it hard-deletes, for object-store cleanup; answers no visibility question
Rows the Work cascade deleted, by deleted_by_work_id: history of Work-owned sources
Yjs engine: a document's schema by id for a live or draft room the caller already holds; grants nothing
Activity side effect keyed by an id from a committed edit; returns no document to anyone
Certified derive: projection and links of any row by id under its generation/location CAS
